summary.text: The Ghirapur Grand Prix is a death-defying interplanar circuit race, begun as an illegal street race on Avishkar and billed as the Multiverse's premier combat sporting event.

bio.text: The chaotic inaugural Grand Prix, the first multiplanar race, crossed nearly two dozen planes, with some teams killed or lost, and Kylem's Cloudspire Racing Team won.
The Avishkar Assembly then expanded it into an annual festival open to teams from many planes, and the second race had the Aetherspark as its grand prize.
The second race started in Ghirapur, crossed Amonkhet and Muraganda, where dinosaurs and Saurid raiders hindered racers, and returned to Ghirapur, with Gonti firing the signal flare to start it.

All teams reached the final stage despite hazards and a dragonstorm, but a coup led by Mohar Varma trapped many racers at the finish line, revealed Sita as a captain, and failed, and Mohar was jailed.

status.text: The second Grand Prix has concluded in the latest material; Zahur is recorded as crossing the finish line first and winning the Aetherspark, while the coup at the finish line failed.
